Tree 948b9a6005a056c97f10d181c589b5352d6221f3

Screenshots are actual, unmodified captures. Prototype and application have different fictional records, counts, lesson versions and lifecycle states; each panel labels its state. No pixel equivalence is claimed. “Learning insights” compares the legacy application page with the prototype's corresponding concern workspace because the prototype has no exact route of that name. Native 200% geometry must pass and PNG completeness must be inspected separately.
